partially_covered.missing: Organization and Address classes still lack detailed attributes (e.g., contact name, phone, email, legal form). Only Address and Identifier are present, so queries about other organization details cannot be answered.

ValidationConstraint class is present, but there are still no explicit OWL axioms or SHACL shapes enumerating mandatory fields (e.g., invoice number, buyer identifier, etc.). Logical consistency is implied but not formally specified.

cq_coverage.details: All core EDIFACT and business questions are answerable using the ontology's classes and properties. However, queries about detailed organization attributes and explicit validation logic remain only partially supported.

issues: HIGH PRIORITY: :hasDate uses xsd:string as range for date values; should use xsd:dateTime or xsd:dateTimeStamp for OWL 2 DL compliance.

strengths: Rich and deep hierarchy for EDIFACT and business concepts
Comprehensive use of restrictions and equivalence
weaknesses: No General Class Axioms (GCAs) for complex role or itemization logic
Disjointness only partially used (mainly for sections and roles)
ValidationConstraint class is not elaborated with actual constraints
Date handling is not OWL 2 compliant

likely_oops_pitfalls: P8: Use of xsd:string for date values instead of xsd:dateTime or xsd:dateTimeStamp
P4: Domain/range coverage is good, but monitor for future additions
P7: Inverse properties are present for major relations
reasoner_risks: Hermit/Pellet will fail to recognize :hasDate as a date property due to xsd:string usage; date-related reasoning will be impossible

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Change the range of :hasDate from xsd:string to xsd:dateTime or xsd:dateTimeStamp to comply with OWL 2 DL and enable date-based reasoning.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Removes validator risk, enables correct date queries and reasoning.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Extend Organization and Address classes to include contact name, email, phone, and legal form to fully answer CQ5.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables detailed queries about organizations, improving CQ5 coverage.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Define explicit OWL axioms or SHACL shapes for ValidationConstraint to enumerate mandatory fields and logical consistency (e.g., invoice number, buyer identifier, item price summation).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Supports automated validation and clearer specification of EDIFACT/EN16931 requirements, fully answering CQ13.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) for roles (e.g., define BuyerRole as an AgentRole played by an Organization in context of InvoiceMessage).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enhances reasoning and semantic richness of role assignments.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand disjointness axioms for all major subclasses (e.g., all Segment subclasses, all AgentRole subclasses).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Reduces ambiguity and improves data validation.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add code lists or controlled vocabularies for segment/element codes (e.g., BGM function codes, NAD party qualifiers).

summary: The ontology maintains strong coverage and quality for modeling EDIFACT invoice structures and business processes, with deep hierarchy and robust use of OWL features. However, it still lacks detailed organization attributes and explicit validation logic, and introduces a critical OWL 2 compliance issue by using xsd:string for date values. Addressing these gaps will improve both operational use and validator compatibility.

suggestions_ignored: Extend Organization and Address with more attributes for CQ5
Define explicit validation constraints for CQ13
Change :hasDate to use xsd:dateTime or xsd:dateTimeStamp
Add code lists for EDIFACT segment/element codes
improvement_tracking.notes: No substantive changes since previous iteration; all high-priority and medium-priority suggestions remain unaddressed, and a new critical compliance issue (xsd:string for date) is now flagged. Coverage and quality scores are unchanged.
